caseName: Aluminum Co. of America v. United States

attorneys: Dickson R. Loos for appellants., Solicitor General Marshall, Assistant Attorney General Turner, Howard E. Shapiro, Robert W. Ginnane and Leonard S. Goodman for the United States et al. Harry B. LaTourette and Robert H. Stahlheber for rail carrier appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.
